description.title: זמני טיפול בתביעה
description.summary: This table details claim handling times for Clalit members. It shows the expected duration for various steps in the claims process, from initial form submission to final decision.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מציגה את זמני הטיפול בתביעות עבור חברי כללית. ניתן למצוא כאן את משך הזמן הצפוי עבור שלבים שונים בתהליך התביעה, החל מהגשת טופס התביעה ועד להחלטה סופית. הזמנים משתנים בהתאם לאופן הגשת התביעה, כגון יצירת קשר טלפוני או פנייה בכתב. לדוגמה, שליחת טופס התביעה באמצעות יצירת קשר ישיר לוקחת יום עסקים אחד, בעוד שפנייה בכתב עשויה לקחת חמישה ימי עסקים. כמו כן, הטבלה מציינת זמנים לביצוע הערכה תפקודית, קבלת תוצאות הבדיקה וקבלת חוות דעת של ספק מכריע. זמני הטיפול בתביעה, יצירת קשר טלפוני, פנייה בכתב, הערכה תפקודית, חוות דעת ספק מכריע.

טבלה: זמני טיפול בתביעה
This table details claim handling times for Clalit members. It shows the expected duration for various steps in the claims process, from initial form submission to final decision.
ממדים: Claim process step, Method of claim submission / process stage

Claim handling times
0,1,2
Sending the claim form by means of the insured contacting the insurer/agent,Direct contact (telephone/visit to our offices),1 business day
Sending the claim form by means of the insured contacting the insurer/agent,contact in writing (post/fax),5 business days
Telephonic contact by a personal representative,Direct contact (telephone/visit to our offices),2 business days after receipt of the documents
Telephonic contact by a personal representative,Contact in writing (post/fax),5 business days after receipt of the documents
Opening a claim and contacting relevant entities to obtain all necessary information,2 business days after receipt of documents,
Decision without an examination,A decision based solely on documents,Up to 20 business days from after notification regarding receipt of the documents.
"In the event that the company decides that the information is insufficient to ascertain eligibility, the insured will be referred to undergo a determining functional assessment",Contacting the insured in order to schedule the examination,3 business days after deciding that the examination is required
"In the event that the company decides that the information is insufficient to ascertain eligibility, the insured will be referred to undergo a determining functional assessment",Performing the examination,3 business days after contacting the insured
"In the event that the company decides that the information is insufficient to ascertain eligibility, the insured will be referred to undergo a determining functional assessment",Provision of the examination results to the insured and the company,3 business days after the examination
"In the event that the company decides that the information is insufficient to ascertain eligibility, the insured will be referred to undergo a determining functional assessment",Deciding (confirmation/ refusal) the claim based on the functional assessment,15 business days after receipt of the assessment
"In the event that the company decides that the information is insufficient to ascertain eligibility, the insured will be referred to undergo a determining functional assessment",Correction of a clerical error and/or referral for perusal by a deciding supplier,3 business days
"In the event that the company decides that the information is insufficient to ascertain eligibility, the insured will be referred to undergo a determining functional assessment",Opinion by the deciding supplier,5 business days after a request by the company
"In the event that the company decides that the information is insufficient to ascertain eligibility, the insured will be referred to undergo a determining functional assessment",The insured requesting the assessment results from the company,3 business days
